name: Pacific NEUC - middle jet
scope: Declared western-to-central middle NEUC component reach between OSW 135 E and 175 E gates. Near-western latitude context is 13 N; all connecting latitudes and bends are editorial. Excludes other NEUC components, 3 N SCC/Tsuchiya jet, western source paths and eastern continuation. Not a whole-component or parent-system length.
layer: Argo P-vector absolute geostrophic zonal velocity on 27.0 sigma-theta (kg/m3), spatially varying depth. Not LICOM/SODA velocity, uniform depth, or the 3 N Tsuchiya jet.
time_convention: 2004-2014 Argo climatological mean, year precision; not a dated observed axis or monthly geometry. Model periods 1969-2007 are not transferred.
source_locator: Li et al. (2018) complete JATS Results / Mean Structures of NEUCs: three Argo jets near 8/13/18 N at 130-135 E, tilting southwest-northeast. Figure 1(a) reviewed; Figure 2 samples 135-140 E and 175-180 E. Neither source curve nor velocity field digitized.
source_citation: Li, Liu and Lin (2018), Interannual and decadal variability of the North Equatorial Undercurrents in an eddy-resolving ocean model, Scientific Reports 8, 17112, doi:10.1038/s41598-018-35469-2.
source_license: CC BY 4.0 original article; attributed source facts and independent OSW geography. Existing licensed Figure 1 retained separately; no source curve digitization.
coordinate_selection: Source supports the declared regional geography or study-domain convention. OSW selects all gates, rounded connecting vertices and alternative bends; no velocity axis or source trajectory reconstructed. Independent longitude and endpoint-latitude shifts describe drawing choices, not current width, source position errors or seasonal extrema.

scenario_rule: Three declared shapes with three longitude shifts and independent three-value endpoint latitude shifts: 81 retained editorial scenarios, not statistical uncertainty or annual variation.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
